Subject: BYOK pilot: evidence & retention questions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we prepare the internal paperwork for the BYOK pilot, the compliance team needs some concrete answers we can attach to our risk assessment and procurement packet. Can you please confirm the following for the pilot (and note when you can provide evidence):

- Audit log retention options available for hosted deployments (default and configurable windows).
- Which audit events are emitted (high level list) and whether logs include key-access events.
- Whether we can provision a separate CMK (customer-managed key) per tenant and share the rotation policy.*

We have attached our evidence template to show the format the auditors prefer. If you can reply with a proposed owner and ETA for each item, that would be really helpful.

Also looping in Procurement to make sure the timeline aligns with contracting.

Thanks,

Thanks Jordan — quick triage from security/product side. Short answers first, then recommended action items.

Short answers (we can produce concrete artifacts):
- Retention: hosted default = 90 days. Configurable per-account windows = 7, 30, 90, 365 days; we can support a custom retention export for >365 on request.
- Audit events: emit high-level event types including: request.create, request.complete, token.generate, key.access, key.rotate, key.revoke, user.authz.change, admin.config.change. Key access events include requester identity, operation, and key-id.
- Per-tenant CMK: yes — we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) per tenant. Keys can be placed in the customer's cloud KMS or in our managed KMS in escrow; for pilots we typically use customer KMS in the same cloud region.
- Evidence: we can provide a sample audit extract (CSV) showing key.rotate and key.access events, a redacted rotation proof (timestamp + signing hash), and a short playbook PDF that maps events to controls.

Recommended action items and owners:
- Irene: assemble sample audit extract (CSV) with 10 key events, redaction-safe, include column mapping by EOD 9/10. Attachment: kms-rotation-diagram.svg (for reference).
- Priyom: confirm retention configuration UI/API and provide a short how-to and API call examples for setting retention windows by 9/10. Add link to internal FAQ.
- Marissa: confirm whether per-tenant KMS is a GA feature for hosted tier or needs a special enablement flag for pilots; propose any required UI/terms change by 9/11.
- Jordan: I can own the composite artifact for ClearHealth (single zip with CSV + playbook + how-to).

Notes / caveats:
- For SOC2 reviewers we should avoid raw PII in extracts; we will redact user identifiers and provide mapping as needed under NDA.
- If ClearHealth prefers an escrow model (we hold the key), procurement needs to sign the ESCROW addendum; that will add ~2 business days.

Drive sample: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cCLEARHEALTH
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4122

Attachment: kms-rotation-diagram.svg (image/svg+xml)

Kimberly Park
Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
